optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Rollout Project Manager, Warehouse Robotics Deployment

professionalSummary.text: Successfully took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, managing the cut-over from manual picking during weekend transitions and the first live picking shift on Monday mornings.
professionalSummary.witness: Took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking at each site over a weekend and the first live picking shift on the Monday morning.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with customer shift leaders, resolving stoppages documented with cause, fix, and clearance details.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with the customer's shift leaders and handled the stoppages raised during hypercare; the stoppage log for each site records the cause, the fix and who cleared it.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated installation schedules with field engineering for all nine sites six weeks pre-go-live through weekly installation reviews with field leads.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the installation schedule with field engineering for each site in the six weeks before go-live, holding the weekly installation review with the field lead.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted pre-go-live acceptance tests with customers at all nine sites, securing signed acceptance records from operations managers prior to cut-over.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer on the installed system at each site, with the acceptance record signed by the customer's operations manager before cut-over.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored site closure reports for all nine warehouses, detailing system limitations, open remote support items, and agreed hand-over conditions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the site closure report for each warehouse, listing the known limitations of the system at that site, the open items for remote support and the hand-over conditions agreed with the customer.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided work samples including go-live/hypercare plans, stoppage logs, signed acceptance records, and closure reports for the most recent site, with site numbers as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the go-live and hypercare plan for the most recent site, its stoppage log, the signed acceptance record and the site closure report, with the site numbers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Site go-live execution, hypercare management, installation scheduling, acceptance testing, and closure reporting for warehouse robotics deployments.
skills.witness: All experience highlights and work samples demonstrate these skills.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish all five requirements through the candidate's experience highlights, work samples, and recruiter/hiring manager notes. No evidence gaps are identified for the requirements.

decisionBoundary.statement: All requirements are supported by evidence; human review required to verify site numbers and stoppage logs as per hiring manager's pre-read.

role.roleTitle: Rollout Project Manager, Warehouse Robotics Deployment

evidence.text: Took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking at each site over a weekend and the first live picking shift on the Monday morning.
evidence.notes: Confirms nine sites, cut-over process, and weekend transition.

evidence.text: Ran the hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with the customer's shift leaders and handled the stoppages raised during hypercare; the stoppage log for each site records the cause, the fix and who cleared it.
evidence.notes: Confirms hypercare management and stoppage documentation.

evidence.text: Coordinated the installation schedule with field engineering for each site in the six weeks before go-live, holding the weekly installation review with the field lead.
evidence.notes: Confirms coordination with field engineering and weekly reviews.

evidence.text: Ran the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer on the installed system at each site, with the acceptance record signed by the customer's operations manager before cut-over.
evidence.notes: Confirms acceptance testing and signed records.

evidence.text: Wrote the site closure report for each warehouse, listing the known limitations of the system at that site, the open items for remote support and the hand-over conditions agreed with the customer.

supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the site closure report for each warehouse, listing the known limitations of the system at that site, the open items for remote support and the hand-over conditions agreed with the customer.
